title: validate_session_urls returns InvalidArgument for server-provided session URLs
description: validate_session_urls() in client.rs returns ClientError::InvalidArgument when a session URL has a non-http/https scheme. Session URLs (api_url, upload_url, download_url, event_source_url) come from the server's Session document — they are not caller-supplied arguments. A malformed or hostile server providing a bad scheme is a session document defect, not a caller argument error. The correct variant is ClientError::InvalidSession ("session URL has non-http/https scheme: ..."), consistent with how other server-side validation failures are reported.
